title: What We Must Show: Borwein Integrals and Fourier Transforms
full_prompt: Write a ManimGL scene named `WhatWeNeedToShow` that visualizes the mathematical setup for Borwein integrals. The scene should display a title 'What we must show' with a stylized underline. Below the title, display a grid of Fourier transform identities and examples (e.g., FT of sinc, FT of sinc with scaling, integral evaluation, convolution theorem). In the lower half, set up two coordinate systems side-by-side: one for the time domain (t) showing a sinc function, and one for the frequency domain (omega) showing a rectangular function. Use a `ValueTracker` to dynamically scale the sinc function and the corresponding rectangular function, demonstrating the scaling property of the Fourier transform.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Using Manim Community Axes methods or missing bind_graph_to_func which is specific to ManimGL
common_failure_modes.note: Manim Community does not have bind_graph_to_func. In Manim CE, one must use always_redraw or custom updaters to update graphs.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Incorrect coordinate mapping or updater crashes when k approaches zero
common_failure_modes.note: Ensure the value tracker for k does not reach 0 to avoid division by zero in the rect function width.
